en.title: Memories Beneath the Calm, Echoes of the Lighthouse
en.premise: Genji, a retired lighthouse keeper, lived a quiet life by the sea, moving in rhythm with the ebb and flow of the tides. But following a great storm, the tide recedes to an unnatural degree, revealing fragments of ancient ruins on the seabed. Guided by a "secret map" found among his grandfather's belongings, a young villager named Kaito is drawn toward the ruins. It is a voyage that leads to lost memories and the truths the ocean has long guarded.

zh.title: 凪底之记忆，灯塔的回响
zh.premise: 退休的灯塔守护者源次，过着随着潮汐涨落而变幻的海边宁静生活。某场风暴过后，潮水异常退去，海底显露出了令人联想到古文明的海底遗迹碎片。村里的青年海斗，带着在祖父遗物中发现的“秘密地图”，被引向了那片遗迹。那是一条通往失落记忆，以及大海守护至今的真相的航路。
